name: fullgpu-render
description: Programmatic video rendering that stays on the GPU end to end (NVDEC -> wgpu/WebGPU -> NVENC)

scripts.test: node --test sdk/cli.test.mjs sdk/react/runtime.test.mjs sdk/animation.test.mjs sdk/compose.test.mjs scene/scene.test.mjs tools/verify.test.mjs tools/bench.test.mjs browser/server.test.mjs
scripts.examples: node sdk/render.mjs examples/app-promo.mjs out/app-promo.mp4 && node sdk/render.mjs examples/benchmark-story.mjs out/benchmark-story.mp4 && node sdk/render.mjs examples/multilingual-titles.mjs out/multilingual-titles.mp4 && node sdk/render.mjs examples/social-vertical.mjs out/social-vertical.mp4 && node sdk/render.mjs examples/launch-video.mjs out/launch-video.mp4 && node sdk/render.mjs examples/launch-video-es.mjs out/launch-video-es.mp4
